title: A/E for Front Facility Improvements
short_description: Design services for major upgrades, renovations, and repairs to state-managed facilities in Columbus.
project_scope: Major facility upgrades, renovations, and repair works within the Ohio Department of Administrative Services managed building portfolio, specifically including Front Facility Improvements FY27 under project number DAS-260015. The notice references a broader portfolio of facility improvement projects including Front, Riffe, SOCC, Rhodes, Surface, and NHC facilities. Total construction cost stated as 10.7 million for the project package/context provided.
services: A/E services including survey and assessment, design, Construction Manager at Risk bidding and procurement assistance, and construction administration; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, fire protection, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a general building renovation and facility improvement project, not a clearly identifiable special structure or bridge.
- Structural engineering is included, but as one discipline among many in a broad A/E scope.
- No indication of long spans, lightweight structures, architecturally exceptional buildings, or innovative structural systems.
- Public building refurbishment can be relevant in principle, but this notice appears focused on general facility upgrades and repairs.
- Therefore only limited strategic fit for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost stated as $10.7M.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information provided in the tender documents.
references_qualifications: Specific reference or qualification requirements are not stated in the provided source excerpt. The notice seeks A/E firms with capabilities across architecture, rehabilitation/refurbishment, civil, structural, environmental, fire protection, and mechanical engineering, plus survey/assessment, procurement assistance, and construction administration.
contracting_authority: Ohio Department of Administrative Services (ODAS), Office of Properties and Facilities (OPF), Columbus, Ohio, USA. Contact: OFCC Procurement. Phone: 614-466-6511. Email: procurement@ofcc.ohio.gov. Website: https://ofcc.ohio.gov/project-opportunities/bids-rfqs/qualifications-based-rfqs/qualification-based-rfqs
notes: Project number: DAS-260015. Funding: State. Questions deadline: 05/15/2026 02:00 PM EDT. Contract participation goal: EDGE 5%. The source lists several FY27 facility improvement projects; it is somewhat unclear whether the stated construction cost applies solely to Front Facility Improvements or to the broader package/context.
